title: Anabaptist Church History
description: Explore the people, stories, and living traditions of Anabaptist church history, from Christian beginnings to the present.

sources.title: Martyrs’ Mirror
sources.author: Thieleman J. van Braght
sources.description: The supplied English edition, translated by Joseph F. Sohm. Its text and 45 images are preserved with the original document and source anchors. Historical wording and dates are attributed to the book, including where they differ from later scholarship.

sources.title: Church History timeline photographs
sources.author: Photographs supplied by the site owner
sources.description: Forty supplied research photographs of the Anabaptist and Mennonite history chart and related exhibits. Their information is presented through the redesigned vertical timeline and historical articles; the photographs are retained in the repository.

sources.title: Behalt cyclorama
sources.author: Heinz Gaugel
sources.description: The supplied IMG_9359 recording and mural-containing exhibit panels helped explain the history chart. Behalt by Heinz Gaugel and the Amish & Mennonite Heritage Center are acknowledged as research sources; the media is excluded from publication.
